# LaunchLive Studio

> LaunchLive Studio (https://www.launchlive.studio) is a full-service digital agency engineering high-performance websites, bespoke AI systems, autonomous workflows, and modern brand identities for scaling startups and enterprises.

## Core Services

- [Website Development](https://www.launchlive.studio/services/websites): High-performance, sub-second Next.js web applications, headless Shopify stores, and web apps optimized for Core Web Vitals and conversions.
- [AI System Creation](https://www.launchlive.studio/services/systems): Enterprise RAG pipelines, private vector search architectures (pgvector, Qdrant), multi-agent orchestration (LangGraph, CrewAI), and autonomous business workflows.
- [SEO & Generative Engine Optimization (GEO)](https://www.launchlive.studio/services/seo): Advanced technical SEO, semantic JSON-LD entity graph engineering, and Answer Engine Optimization (AEO) to secure citations in ChatGPT, Perplexity, and Google AI Overviews.
- [AI Tool Creation](https://www.launchlive.studio/services/ai-tools): Custom micro-SaaS software, real-time voice agents (WebSockets, TTS/STT), intelligent document OCR parsers, and fine-tuned SLM integrations.
- [Marketing & CRM Automation](https://www.launchlive.studio/services/automation): Event-driven webhook pipelines, automated CRM lead routing (HubSpot, Salesforce), dynamic nurture sequences, and retention workflows.
- [UI/UX Design](https://www.launchlive.studio/services/design): Conversion-focused interface design, comprehensive Figma design systems, WCAG 2.2 accessibility, and fluid micro-interactions.
- [Branding & Identity](https://www.launchlive.studio/services/branding): Strategy-first visual identities, brand motion design tokens, typography psychology, and positioning strategies.
- [Growth Consulting](https://www.launchlive.studio/services/consulting): 90-day digital growth roadmaps, tech stack architecture audits, SaaS unit economics optimization, and digital transformation advisory.

## Featured Work & Case Studies

- [LaunchLive RAG Platform](https://www.launchlive.studio/work): Enterprise due-diligence and RAG platform with automated third-party risk analysis and audit workflows.
- [DeepShield Risk Operation Center](https://www.launchlive.studio/work): B2B Trust & Safety command center monitoring owner onboarding and payout risk, reducing fraudulent activity by 70%.
- [Montbold DTC E-Commerce](https://www.launchlive.studio/work): Minimalist luxury DTC e-commerce storefront generating $0 → $120k revenue in 90 days post-launch.
- [Raptile Studio](https://www.launchlive.studio/work): High-performance custom Shopify streetwear storefront with liquid animations, delivered 1 week ahead of schedule.
